overview.description: Zhào Péngyou ('Finding Friends') is a Chinese multi-player trick-taking game. 5-12 players. Multiple decks + jokers. Trump maker 'calls' specific cards — holders become secret partners (kankei). Point cards: 5=5pts, 10/K=10pts (100 total). Teams level up through ranks. First to Ace level wins.

history.origins: Zhào Péngyou (Looking for Friends) is a Chinese trick-taking game in the Shēng Jí (升级, raise level) family, alongside Dă Băi Fēn (打百分, 100) and Tractor (拖拉机). These games share level-as-card-rank progression and King-Ten-Five point scoring. The variant with variable, secret partnerships called by the trump maker is popular across China and is one of the few trick-taking games that scales well to 6–12 players. The aim is to win tricks containing Kings, Tens and Fives while teammates are revealed only when the called cards are played.
timeline: Chinese King-Ten-Five (Shēng Jí 升级) family game; popular across China.
history.evolution: Evolved within the Shēng Jí family; variable-partnership form (call cards for secret teammates) distinguishes it from fixed-partnership 100 and Tractor. Now widely played across China.
history.cultural: Played as a social party game for large groups; secret partner revelation and level progression make it engaging for 5–12 players.

setup.deck: Multiple decks with jokers. 54 cards per deck.

rules.objective: Level up through ranks. First team to Ace level wins.
rules.gameplay: Trump maker calls specific cards = secret partners. Follow suit. Trump if void. Lead singles/pairs/tractors. 5=5pts, 10/K=10pts. Last trick = double points. Win enough points to level up.

trumpConfig.trumpSuitRanking: Red joker, black joker, trump rank+suit card, then other cards of trump rank (equal), then trump suit A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2. Non-trump suits rank A high to 2 low.
trumpConfig.overtakingRule: Must follow suit if possible; may trump when void. Highest trump wins; if no trump, highest of led suit. First played wins ties.

trickConfig.leadRestrictions: Trump maker leads first trick; thereafter winner of previous trick leads.

edgeCases.text: If no one exposes a card during deal, redeal by same starter.
Trump maker takes kitty and discards same number face down; those cards count for last-trick winner (doubled).
Called cards must not be trumps; holder of first/second/third copy played becomes secret partner.
Between equal cards, first played wins.
Lead can be single, set of identical cards, sequence of sets (tractors), or group of top cards; others must contribute same number and follow suit when possible.

engine.deckDescription: Multiple standard 52-card French packs with jokers: 5-7 players use 2 packs, 8-11 use 3 packs, 12 use 4 packs. Jokers (red and black) are added so cards divide evenly with a kitty of 6 or 8. Suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades. Ranks A, K, Q, J, 10 down to 2.
engine.suitDescription: French suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades. One suit is named trump each deal by the trump maker.
engine.rankDescription: Standard order A high to 2 low. One rank is trump each deal (same as players' level). Trump rank cards in non-trump suit count as one rank for following.
engine.dealPattern: Anticlockwise: each player in turn takes one card from the top of the pack until everyone has full hand; 6 or 8 cards remain as kitty.

notApplicableReasons.drawConfig: This game does not use a draw pile during play.
notApplicableReasons.discardConfig: Discards are the trump maker's kitty only; no general discard pile.
